title: IntNet: A Communication-Driven Multi-Agent Reinforcement Learning Framework for Cooperative Autonomous Driving
abstract: arXiv:2610.34466v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Achieving safety in autonomous driving through Multi-Agent Reinforcement Learning (MARL) is a critical yet challenging task due to non-stationarity, partial observability, and the need for effective coordination among agents. Although earlier cooperative MARL methods have aimed to improve coordination by sharing encoded state observations, we find these strategies are insufficient in safety-critical scenarios. To address this gap, we present IntNet, a novel MARL framework that enhances safety by incorporating the transmission of vehicle intent and adaptive communication scheduling into a unified end-to-end learning paradigm, jointly optimising all components for safe coordination. Central to our approach is an observation prediction module that enables agents to forecast subsequent policy outputs, which they can then share across a vehicle-to-vehicle network. translated_title: IntNet：一种面向协同自动驾驶的通信驱动多智能体强化学习框架
translated_abstract: 通过多智能体强化学习（MARL）实现自动驾驶的安全性是一项关键但充满挑战的任务，其原因在于环境的非平稳性、部分可观测性以及智能体之间需要进行有效协调。尽管早期的协同MARL方法旨在通过共享编码的状态观测来改善协调，但我们发现这些策略在安全关键场景中是不充分的。为解决这一不足，我们提出了IntNet，这是一种新颖的MARL框架，它通过将车辆意图传输和自适应通信调度纳入统一的端到端学习范式来增强安全性，并对所有组件进行联合优化以实现安全协调。我们方法的核心是一个观测预测模块，使智能体能够预测后续的策略输出，然后通过车对车网络进行共享。我们的无模型架构采用图注意力网络来处理（原文在此截断）。
tldr: IntNet提出了一种通信驱动的多智能体强化学习框架，通过将车辆意图传输与自适应通信调度融入统一的端到端学习范式并联合优化，显著提升了安全关键场景下协同自动驾驶的安全性。
en_tdlr: IntNet is a communication-driven multi-agent reinforcement learning framework that enhances safety in cooperative autonomous driving by integrating vehicle intent transmission and adaptive communication scheduling into a unified end-to-end learning paradigm with joint optimization of all components.
